name: Python
description: Latest stable release of Python Programming Language

command.script: which apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip || which pacman >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo pacman -S --noconfirm python python-pip || which dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo dnf install -y python3 python3-pip || echo 'Instala Python mediante tu gestor de paquetes'
which brew >/dev/null 2>&1 && brew install python || echo 'Instala Python con Homebrew (brew install python)'
